messages:
maya: Heads up — found a service-account client cert leaked in ci logs for service 'embedder-worker' (eu-west). pasted snippet below, saw full PEM exposed in build-logs.

maya: ```
[ci-run] tail -n 40 pipeline.log
...
--- START CERT ---
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MIIF...
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
--- END CERT ---
```

dom: yikes. do we know the cert serial / expiry? can we revoke fast?

sri: quick plan: rotate & revoke, rewrap KMS key versions, scan audit logs, and tighten issuer RBAC. need to consider proxy cert caches in eu-west.

alice: i'm kicking off a dry-run rotation for eu-west now, will run rotator in dry-run mode first and post simulated steps.

alice: ```
rotator rotate --service embedder-worker --region eu-west --dry-run --output=steps
```

oncall-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-5823 — "embedder-worker ci cert exposure (eu-west)". Assigned: alice, dom. Priority: P2.

dom: good. concrete items:
- revoke cert via CA (issue CRL / OCSP revoke)
- create new client cert with short ttl (24h) and rotate
- rewrap new cert with new KMS key version
- remove KMS wrap privilege from CI runner SA
- check audit logs for any decrypt/wrap ops since 2026-03-10
- purge proxy caches / invalidate TLS session caches

sri: for proxy cache purge use internal API, and schedule a staged proxy rollout to avoid global blips.

sri: command to purge SNI cache (eu-west proxies):
```
curl -X POST "https://proxy-api.internal/eu-west/purge" -d '{"service":"embedder-worker"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROXY_TOKEN"
```

security-rotator: note: when rewrapping, prefer creating a new key version and using kms:RewrapKey. fallback: generate ephemeral key and rotate quickly. also publish audit event via auditstream with tag = "rotator:embedder-worker".

security-rotator: sample KMS rewrap CLI:
```
kmsctl rewrap --key old-key-id --new-key new-key-id --resource projects/redwood/keys/embedder-worker --region eu-west
```

alice: rotation started for eu-west. revocation request submitted to CA. revoker returned OK. new cert issued with ttl=24h.

dom: push PR to remove kms.wrap from ci-runner role and grant kms.wrap to rotator-service only. also add iam condition limiting wrap to projects/embedder-worker.

maya: will we get intermittent 503s because of session resumption caches?

sri: expect a brief window. mitigations: bump healthcheck thresholds, stagger proxy restarts, and set TLS session ticket eviction via config: `session_ticket_ttl=30s` for rollout window.

alice: done: rotator ran, new cert deployed, old cert revoked. KMS logs show wrap/unwrap for new key only. auditstream events:
```
[2026-03-12T14:03:21Z] rotator:embedder-worker rewrap new-key-id success
[2026-03-12T14:03:30Z] ca: revoke old-serial success
```

dom: double-check: any unexpected external decrypts in audit? maya — can you run quick SIEM query for accesses to the old cert material in last 30 days?

maya: SIEM query ran, found only internal CI runner reads; no external IPs. forwarding logs to incident ticket.

alice: follow-up: opened PR: #infra/rotator-rbac-lockdown. changes: remove kms.wrap from `ci-runner@build` SA, add conditional binding for `rotator@infra` with limiter on resource name. also added audit retention increase for `kms.rewrap` events to 1y.

security-rotator: recommend creating a short-lived delegated issuer role for emergency rotation and an automated smoke test that validates mTLS handshake post-rotation across regions (eu-west, us-central, ap-south).

alice: scheduled smoke tests and a postmortem. marking incident resolved in ticket after 24h observation window. will keep the audit/channel open for 48h.

maya: thanks everyone. main action items captured in the ticket. moving to monitoring mode. :thumbsup:
